folds.heading: ## Later checkpoint and current selected source, 2026-11-04 (B87)
folds.body: F1/F3’s no-detail state predates the [completed crafting checkpoint](../CHECKPOINT.md): it delivered list/detail and explicit select → Craft for its named item slice. Current display/detail source still uses an explicit model, inline blocked reason and command handlers; unknown material labels and accessory-derived station tiers have also evolved. This is source evidence, not a current all-recipe keyboard, knowledge or layout verdict. F5 is specifically stale at the receipt producer: current work_ledger_system chooses a settled success from actual output count, allowing partial output with zero whole successes. F6 is stale at the selected native path: use_recipe includes equipment in the staged transaction wrapper, and the equipment branch invokes settleWorkLedgerCraft after actual additions/removals. No new craft/browser/failure/persistence run was performed here. Preserve the old one-save-edit fixture, source-reference limits and measured 1366 geometry as history; they do not prove natural acquisition, current rendering or source-game behavior. Current desktop direction/AD36/AD42/AD43 apply to new claims. No new crafting/settings/runtime work is selected (AD32).

folds.heading: ## Current source follow-through, 2026-11-04 (B87)
folds.body: The [research map correction](research/CRAFTING_MAP.md#later-checkpoint-and-current-selected-source-2026-11-04-b87) reconciles the initial no-detail/partial-output/equipment gaps against later selected source. Equipment’s missing receipt is no longer a current source claim; that does not rerun this checkpoint’s C1–C9, native transaction failure or present UI geometry. The recorded Infested-field substitute remains a declared fixture, and old viewport/test totals remain tied to their bundle. Human review is optional under AD42; the old next-settings suggestion is not current runtime authorization (AD32/AD36).
